the Community Health Units are important for data collection, analysis and use.
The community health units are central for data collection, analysis and use.
the community health workers in Western Kenya use information for community dialogue and that the community needs information on health status and service utilization.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and implementation of a health information system in a rural setting in Kenya, and the use of information for planning and decision-making.
the development of a framework for the design and implementation of an effective HIS in Western Kenya.
the utilization of community based information systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the utilization of information is hindered by the health system and by personal factors.
information is a powerful tool in the community, and that it should be used to empower the community to take action on health issues.
the community health units in the study area were not using information for planning and decision making.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the community health workers are not fully utilizing the data that they have collected.
the community has a need for health information.
there is a need to improve the capacity of the community to use the data for decision-making and planning.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the community has the ability to use health information and the community health workers can play a key role in the utilization of health information.
the community is willing and able to utilize health information if they can be given the tools to do so.
information is not only a commodity but also a tool for empowerment of communities.
